prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the lower center with the mounting brackets bent, and the trunk lid shows a crease that lines up with the reported rear-end impact. The damage pattern is consistent with the collision as described, and no prior damage to this vehicle is on record. The proposed plan is to replace the bumper cover, repair the trunk lid panel, refinish both, and replace the tail lamp assembly on the driver side. Labor hours on the estimate run somewhat high for the scope of this work, so I recommend a line-by-line review before approval. The invoices submitted so far show no repeated charges.
